# notion-sync

> Sync Notion databases and pages to local Markdown files with YAML frontmatter.
> 
> Version: next

This file contains links to documentation sections following the llmstxt.org standard.

## Table of Contents

- [For agents](https://drexel-uhc.github.io/notion-sync/next/agents.md): *How LLM tools should read, and carefully write, a notion-sync workspace.*

- [Install](https://drexel-uhc.github.io/notion-sync/next/getting-started/install.md): *Install, update, or download notion-sync.*
- [Notion setup](https://drexel-uhc.github.io/notion-sync/next/getting-started/notion-setup.md): *Create an integration, share databases with it, and find their IDs.*
- [Quickstart](https://drexel-uhc.github.io/notion-sync/next/getting-started/quickstart.md): *Import, refresh, list.*
- [Guides](https://drexel-uhc.github.io/notion-sync/next/guides.md): *Task-oriented walkthroughs.*
- [Push](https://drexel-uhc.github.io/notion-sync/next/guides/push.md): *Write local property edits — and new rows — back to Notion. Guarded, all-or-nothing.*
- [Introduction](https://drexel-uhc.github.io/notion-sync/next/docs.md): *Sync Notion databases and pages to local Markdown files with YAML frontmatter.*
- [Commands](https://drexel-uhc.github.io/notion-sync/next/reference/commands.md): *Every command and flag.*
- [File URLs](https://drexel-uhc.github.io/notion-sync/next/reference/file-urls.md): *Why S3 links are stripped, and how to fetch the bytes.*
- [Frontmatter](https://drexel-uhc.github.io/notion-sync/next/reference/frontmatter.md): *Metadata keys and how Notion properties map to YAML.*
- [Reference](https://drexel-uhc.github.io/notion-sync/next/reference.md): *Commands, on-disk format, and metadata.*
- [Metadata files](https://drexel-uhc.github.io/notion-sync/next/reference/metadata-files.md): *`_database.json` and `_page.json`.*
- [Workspace layout](https://drexel-uhc.github.io/notion-sync/next/reference/workspace-layout.md): *What's on disk after an import.*
